articles.title: Residents in Saudi Arabia’s capital say they have heard new explosions in Riyadh. - AP News
articles.description: New explosions have been heard in Riyadh, with blame falling again on Iran-backed Houthi rebels from Yemen. The Saudi-led coalition said Wednesday it intercepted a ballistic missile aimed at the capital. There were no immediate reports of casualties or damage…
